patch.title: Artwork catalog presentation integration
patch.description: Maintainer-admitted current-main presentation redesign. Packet: docs/planning/UIQ-05-INTEGRATION-ADMISSION.md; live gates: docs/planning/UIQ-05-GOAL.md. Replace only the existing Surface artwork catalog presentation with the accepted candidate; do not add a duplicate catalog.
patch.expectation: Keep all existing catalog facts and local assets, with an improved native presentation and the existing explicit stage-new / use-for-selected-placement operations preserved. Selection and browsing are non-mutating.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepted UIQ-05 candidate files match immutable candidate evidence exactly; no candidate source/CSS/test/preview edits.
Embedded uiq_artwork is default-on with deterministic local test override; flag off, unknown or stale restores the exact pre-integration library UI.
Existing catalog, search/filter/assessment and rights caveats remain authoritative; only local bundled images are shown and provenance URLs are never fetched.
Selection is ephemeral and does not apply, save or alter design state; separate stage-new and attach-to-valid-placement actions remain explicit and tested.
100% changed production coverage and 100% settled global coverage; build/typecheck, operational, protected output and export-byte-identity gates pass with no baseline changes.
Actual browser/electron presentation checks pass at desktop and narrow sizes, with keyboard/focus, forced colors, reduced motion, safe local images and no-egress evidence.
Codex independently reviews, corrects if needed, and controls merge; Slice 742 verifies deployment/live behavior and evidence-gated board closeout.
